caption: The import window takes .textpack files, a .textbundle folder, or a drop.
eval: (async () => { window.__tb = { p: app.plugins.plugins['textbundle-files'], dir: 'TextBundle Files/Packs/', file: async (name) => new File([new Uint8Array(await app.vault.adapter.readBinary('TextBundle Files/Packs/' + name))], name), open: async (path, mode = 'preview') => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); await leaf.setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: { file: path, mode, source: mode === 'source' } }); }, pro: async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['textbundle-files']; if (!window.__tbHttp) window.__tbHttp = p.pro.opts.http; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('textbundle-files-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); }, free: () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['textbundle-files']; p.pro.signOut(); if (window.__tbHttp) p.pro.opts.http = window.__tbHttp; } }; window.__tb.free(); window.__tb.p.openImport(); return 'Import window'; })()

caption: Each pack becomes a note, and the window lists its attachments and changed links.
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__tb.p.openImport(); const rows = await m.selectFiles([await window.__tb.file('Lisbon trip.textpack'), await window.__tb.file('Screenplay.textpack')]); if (!rows[0] || !rows[0].result) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(rows)); return rows.length + ' rows'; })()

caption: The imported note shows its images from the attachment folder.
eval: (async () => { await window.__tb.open('Lisbon trip.md'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); const n = document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view img').length; if (n < 2) throw new Error('images: ' + n); return n + ' images'; })()

caption: The links in the source point to the vault files.
A pack with a ../ path is refused, and nothing is written.
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__tb.p.openImport(); const rows = await m.selectFiles([await window.__tb.file('Escape.textpack')]); if (!rows[0] || !rows[0].error) throw new Error('not refused'); return rows[0].error; })()

caption: Export current note as TextPack writes the pack next to the note.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); app.commands.executeCommandById('textbundle-files:export-note'); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('TextBundle Files/Garden plan.textpack'); i++) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('TextBundle Files/Garden plan.textpack')) throw new Error('no pack'); return 'Exported'; })()

caption: Pro imports every pack in a folder and writes a report note.
eval: (async () => { await window.__tb.pro(); document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(el => el.remove()); const r = await window.__tb.p.importFolder(app.vault.getFolderByPath('TextBundle Files/Packs')); await window.__tb.open(r.reportPath); window.__tb.free(); return r.reportPath; })()

caption: The settings: auto import of added packs, and the info.json property (Pro).
eval: (async () => { app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('textbundle-files'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return 'ok'; })()
